recommendedNoPlayRules.detail: Treat claimed edge ≥20pp as a caution, not a boost — it has historically UNDER-performed (anti-calibrated). Prefer 5–15pp edges from reliable markets.
Exclude markets with settled hit rate < 52% (e.g. batter_total_bases, pitcher_strikeouts) from Bank Builder.
While the paper sample is not meaningful (<10 settled cards), prefer no-play over a marginal card and never claim a product edge.

selectorChangesRecommended.change: Require every leg's market to clear the reliability floor + cap at 2–3 distinct-game legs.
Never add a weak-market leg just to reach the payout floor; require distinct games + keep paper-only until a real sample.
Do NOT up-weight a pick by confidence tier until a re-derived tier out-hits monotonically on a holdout (tiers are currently anti-predictive).
